importantFindings: Atlantic 37 is the direct Prairie 36 successor and should not be treated as unrelated design lineage.
Atlantic Boat/Duffy 26 production start is corrected to 1986; the same hull has commercial, launch and yacht finishes, so displacement/tankage are not forced model-wide.
BHM 32 Flye Point is a Spencer Lincoln semi-custom Downeast design; model-wide completion dimensions remain conservative.
Seaway 24 historical propulsion is not safely one universal code; the family includes outboard and diesel inboard/I-O variants.
Sisu 22 continued through different builders/propulsion eras, so fuel and propulsion remain configuration-specific.
Sisu 26 strong published dimensions are 25 ft 11 in x 9 ft 8 in x 2 ft 9 in at about 7,200 lb; both gas and diesel direct-drive examples exist.
Original True North 34 derives from the 2003 True North 33 and is a 22–25 knot planing-capable diesel Downeast cruiser, not semi-displacement.
Windy factory heritage confirms 7.75 m LOA, 2.93 m beam and 2,350 kg weight, but not draft; conflicting draft evidence means draft is now unresolved.
Luhrs 30 Alura had a 1988 keel redesign, represented as a production phase.
Pilgrim 40 is a H. Ted Gozzard/North Castle full-displacement single-diesel motor yacht.
Eagle 32 Pilothouse is strongly documented as a full-displacement Transpacific Marine trawler with protected running gear and separate shower.
